head_contract: os-v2 unified head (os/pagehead-redesign.html) applied to all 9 settings sections: topbar + icon-tile page head replaced by drill-in w2head (back chevron + trail Settings / <Section>, max 1 primary + overflow); old head desc/meta demoted to a 12px subhead line (.subhead, or .pagesub in settings-memory where .subhead was taken; settings-network renamed its in-content .subhead to .adv-subhead). Real actions preserved (e.g. New provider); live states stay in content boards, never duplicated in the head. settings-design-system.html intentionally left on the old pattern as the catalog of it.

clarity.notes: One decision per row with a consequence sentence; jargon chips demoted to Advanced-only provchips; save semantics named per model (draft / per-item / immediate).

hierarchy.notes: Takeover shell removes the dual-rail problem; head → groups → Advanced → save bar reads top-down; 768px form column vs 960px listing column.

typography.notes: Canon scale verbatim: 1.4rem/600/-.028em titles, 13px/500 row labels, 12px muted descriptions ≤52ch, mono reserved for values/provenance.

motion.notes: State-only motion at 140ms canon easing: save bar appears when dirty, sheet slides 200ms, switch knob 140ms, disclosure chevron rotate; prefers-reduced-motion kills all.

brand.notes: Tokens verbatim from packages/ui lineage; accent restricted to active nav item, primary action and Default pill (state); selection state neutral glaze per radio-card canon.
